en.t: He and I were very close.

units.source_text: 不过，他生前很不愿意让人看出他是我的朋友。

en.t: But while he was alive, he was very reluctant to let anyone see that he was my friend.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，他惟独对我才说心里话。

en.t: Even so, I was the only one to whom he spoke his true feelings.

units.source_text: 他过世已经三年了，他的信也可以让人看了。

en.t: It has already been three years since he passed away, so his letters may now be shown to others.

units.source_text: 特别是你同他很亲密，我早就打算找个机会单独让你看看。"

en.t: Especially because you were close to him, I had long meant to find a chance to let you read them privately.
